configurationFields.label: Servername
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the server that appears in the server list

configurationFields.label: Message Of The Day
configurationFields.description: Sets the message of the day (MOTD) displayed when players join

configurationFields.label: Server Mod Name
configurationFields.description: Sets the name of the mod directory to load, allowing the use of third-party Q3A mods. Don't change this from the default 'baseq3' unless you know what you are doing!

configurationFields.label: Make Server Public
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will be visible publicly. Otherwise it will only be accessible from the LAN

configurationFields.label: Require Server Password
configurationFields.description: If enabled, the server will notify clients that it requires a password to connect. The password must be set under Server Password

configurationFields.label: Serverpasswort
configurationFields.description: Sets the password required to connect to the server. Default is no password. Require Server Password must also be enabled

configurationFields.label: RCON-Passwort
configurationFields.description: See the Security and Privacy menu for configurable options for the server's RCON

configurationFields.label: Private Client Password
configurationFields.description: Sets the password for private clients, if any, to connect to the server. Specify the required number of private clients under Private Client Number. Server Password should not be set

configurationFields.label: Enable Pure Server
configurationFields.description: If set, only unmodified pak files that are also installed on the server can be used by clients, as a hacking and cheat protection

configurationFields.label: Allow Cheats
configurationFields.description: If set, cheats will be allowed on the server

configurationFields.label: Initial Game Type
configurationFields.description: Sets the game type to start the server with

configurationFields.label: Initial Map
configurationFields.description: Sets the map to start the server with.  If "Custom" is selected, Custom Initial Map must also be specified. This setting will be overridden if map rotation is configured in baseq3/server.cfg

configurationFields.label: Custom Initial Map
configurationFields.description: Sets a custom map to use for the Initial Map, if "Custom" is selected

configurationFields.label: Initial Map Type
configurationFields.description: Sets whether the Initial Map allows cheats or not. Allow Cheats must also be enabled to use cheats

configurationFields.label: Client Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players and spectators allowed on the server at one time

configurationFields.label: Game Player Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum number of players (out of the Client Limit) that are able to join the game, while the rest will be spectators. 0 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Private Client Number
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of slots (out of the Client Limit) reserved for private players on a public server. 0 = disabled. Private Client Password must also be set

configurationFields.label: Allow Download From Server
configurationFields.description: If set, clients will be allowed to download content (maps, models, etc) from the server

configurationFields.label: Server FPS
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum frames per second (FPS) that the server sends to clients

configurationFields.label: Server Memory Allocation
configurationFields.description: Sets the amount of memory allocated for map and item loading

configurationFields.label: Minimum Client Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum allowable rate a client may have set when connected to the server. 0 = no minimum (default)

configurationFields.label: Maximum Client Rate
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum allowable rate a client may have set when connected to the server. 0 = no limit (default). Otherwise recommended to be 8000 - 10000 if slower clients are having issues

configurationFields.label: Minimum Client Ping
configurationFields.description: Sets the minimum ping clients can have on the server. 0 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Maximum Client Ping
configurationFields.description: Sets the maximum ping clients can have on the server. 0 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Additional Console Variables
configurationFields.description: Additional console variables that are not otherwise set by GSCS can be specified in 'server.cfg'

configurationFields.label: Enable Bots
configurationFields.description: If set, bots will be enabled on the server

configurationFields.label: Difficulty Level
configurationFields.description: Sets the default difficulty level (skill level of bots) on the server

configurationFields.label: Bot Minimum Players
configurationFields.description: Bots will added to or removed from the server to ensure that the number of players on the server meets the minimum set (subject to client/player limits)

configurationFields.label: Disable Bot Chat
configurationFields.description: If set, bots will be silenced

configurationFields.label: Enable Friendly Fire
configurationFields.description: If enabled, friendly fire will be allowed, so players can damage their own teammates. Standard defaults: TDM - true, CTF - false. No effect for FFA and Tourney game types

configurationFields.label: Frag Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of frags (or kills) that must be reached before a game ends and the next game starts. 0 = no frag limit. Standard defaults: FFA - 15, TDM - 25, CTF - 0

configurationFields.label: Time Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the game time limit, after which a game ends and the next game starts. 0 = no time limit. Standard defaults: FFA - 10, TDM - 15, CTF - 30

configurationFields.label: Capture Limit
configurationFields.description: Sets the number of flags that must be captured for the CTF game type before a game ends and the next game starts

configurationFields.label: Enable Auto Team Joining
configurationFields.description: If set, a new player will automatically join a team when connecting to the server (TDM or CTF game types). Otherwise they will go into spectator mode

configurationFields.label: Enable Forced Team Balancing
configurationFields.description: If set, forces a new player onto the smallest or losing team (TDM or CTF game types). Otherwise, the player can select freely which team to join. Standard defaults: TDM - true, CTF - false

configurationFields.label: Respawn Time Period
configurationFields.description: Sets the respawn time period. 0 = no forced respawn

configurationFields.label: Allow Voting
configurationFields.description: If set, connected players can call for and vote on changes including: map, map restart, kick, and game type

configurationFields.label: Quad Damage Powerup Multiple
configurationFields.description: Sets multiples of damage caused by the quad damage powerup. 3 = default, 1 = no quad damage powerup. Decimals may be used

configurationFields.label: Weapon Respawn Time Period
configurationFields.description: Sets the time period between when a weapon is picked up and when it respawns. Only recommended to be changed from default (5) in FFA servers with a large number of players, in which case it can be lowered slightly. Otherwise not recommended to be modified or set to 0 (weapons stay)

configurationFields.label: Inactivity Kick Time
configurationFields.description: Sets the time period after which inactive players will be kicked from the server. 0 = disabled

configurationFields.label: Enable Synchronous Clients
configurationFields.description: If set, all clients movements are synced to allow demo recording. Recommended to keep off to allow smoother play

configurationFields.label: Enable Flood Protection
configurationFields.description: If set, the server will be protected from being flooded by players via chat

configurationFields.label: Disable Game File Download
configurationFields.description: If set, GSCS will not download the pak0.pk3 game file from Steam when the server is updated. The file will need to be installed manually in the baseq3 directory in the instance's base directory in order for the server to function

deploymentSteps.name: Move Server Files
deploymentSteps.arguments: /C cd  && xcopy /E /Y /I ioquake3\* .\ > NUL 2>&1 && rmdir /Q /S ioquake3 > NUL 2>&1

deploymentSteps.name: Client File Copy
deploymentSteps.arguments: /C xcopy /E /Y /I client\baseq3\pak0.pk3 baseq3\ > NUL 2>&1 && rmdir /Q /S client\ > NUL 2>&1

deploymentSteps.name: Patch Files Copy
deploymentSteps.arguments: /C xcopy /E /Y /I quake3-latest-pk3s\baseq3\*.pk3 baseq3\ > NUL 2>&1 && xcopy /E /Y /I quake3-latest-pk3s\missionpack\*.pk3 missionpack\ > NUL 2>&1 && rmdir /Q /S quake3-latest-pk3s\ > NUL 2>&1

deploymentSteps.name: Server.cfg Download

authenticationRequirements.description: Ein Steam-Konto mit Berechtigung für dieses Spiel hinterlegen. Steam Guard kann einmalig erforderlich sein.
